core_obligations: Identify sections with the stalk (proof lines 8220-8232): the author shows that for a sheaf of sets on the etale site of the spectrum of a strictly henselian local ring the global sections coincide with the stalk at the closed point, because every etale neighbourhood of the closed point admits a section.

Exactness and vanishing (proof lines 8232-8242): since the stalk functor is exact, the global sections functor is exact on abelian sheaves, and hence the higher cohomology of every abelian sheaf vanishes in positive degrees.
proof_roadmap: Show that global sections agree with the stalk at the closed point.
Use exactness of the stalk functor to get exactness of global sections.
Conclude the vanishing of the higher cohomology.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for the spectrum S of a strictly henselian local ring with closed point sbar the global sections functor on abelian sheaves is exact, indeed the global sections of any sheaf of sets are the stalk at sbar, and consequently the higher etale cohomology of every abelian sheaf vanishes (statement lines 8206-8218). The proof identifies the global sections with the stalk at the closed point, using that every etale neighbourhood of the closed point admits a section (proof lines 8220-8232), and then uses exactness of the stalk functor to obtain exactness of global sections and the vanishing (proof lines 8232-8242). The non-formal content is the identification of sections with the stalk. The claim is H2: one identification plus one exactness argument.
